cohort: Women with singleton pregnancy carried to 24 or more weeks gestation
finding: Iron deficiency anemia (IDA) was independently associated with an increased risk of both total PPH and atonic PPH in pregnant women.
mod_finding: Women with iron deficiency anemia had a significantly higher incidence of atonic postpartum hemorrhage despite similar rates of labor induction, augmentation, instrumental delivery, and intrapartum cesarean delivery.
